quests.instruction: Before adding it to guacamole, a cook will often ___ a lime over the mashed avocado. What's the word?
quests.question: Squeeze
quests.hint: This word means pressing a fruit gently to add a splash of its juice.
quests.explanation: Correct! Before adding it to guacamole, a cook will squeeze a lime over the mashed avocado, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This tangy splash also helps keep mashed avocado from turning brown!

quests.instruction: Gooseberries grow on a thorny, low-growing plant called a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Bush
quests.hint: This word names a plant low enough that you don't need to reach up high.
quests.explanation: Super! Gooseberries grow on a thorny, low-growing plant called a bush, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This plant's thorns mean pickers often wear gloves for protection!

quests.instruction: Apples and peaches both grow high up on the branches of a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Tree
quests.hint: This word names a tall, woody plant with branches reaching upward.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Apples and peaches both grow high up on the branches of a tree, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Farmers who grow fruit this way often need tall ladders at harvest time!

quests.instruction: A green banana left on the counter will slowly ___ until it turns yellow and soft. What's the word?
quests.question: Ripen
quests.hint: This word describes the natural process a fruit goes through as it becomes ready to eat.
quests.explanation: You found it! A green banana left on the counter will slowly ripen until it turns yellow and soft, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Some fruits release a natural gas that helps nearby fruit do this even faster!

quests.instruction: Raspberries grow on a thorny plant known as a ___. Which word fits?
quests.question: Bush
quests.hint: This word names a low, branching plant, sometimes covered in small thorns.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Raspberries grow on a thorny plant known as a bush, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Pickers need to watch out for small thorns on this kind of plant!

quests.instruction: Pineapples grow close to the ___, low enough to almost touch the soil. Which word fits?
quests.question: Ground
quests.hint: This word names the surface a low-growing fruit plant spreads across.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Pineapples grow close to the ground, low enough to almost touch the soil, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Surprisingly, this fruit grows low to the earth instead of high on a tall plant!

quests.instruction: Oranges and mangoes both grow high above the ground on a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Tree
quests.hint: This word names a plant with a thick trunk and spreading branches.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Oranges and mangoes both grow high above the ground on a tree, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This plant's blossoms usually need a visit from a bee before fruit can grow!

quests.instruction: Grapes are famous for growing in bunches along a long, winding ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This word names a plant grown along a trellis or fence.
quests.explanation: Yes! Grapes are famous for growing in bunches along a long, winding vine, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Some of these climbing plants can live and produce fruit for over 100 years!

quests.instruction: Honeydews grow low, sitting on the ___ instead of hanging from a branch. Which word matches?
quests.question: Ground
quests.hint: This word names the low surface some sprawling fruit plants grow across.
quests.explanation: That's right! Honeydews grow low, sitting on the ground instead of hanging from a branch, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This low-growing habit is shared by nearly every kind of melon!

quests.instruction: A chef might ___ an orange peel to sprinkle its fragrant bits over a dessert. Which word fits?
quests.question: Zest
quests.hint: This word describes grating just the colorful outer layer of a citrus fruit.
quests.explanation: Great job! A chef might zest an orange peel to sprinkle its fragrant bits over a dessert, matching this word!
quests.funFact: The bright color of a citrus peel almost always means it's full of flavorful oil!

quests.instruction: Cantaloupe plants sprawl low across the ___ rather than climbing upward. Which word fits?
quests.question: Ground
quests.hint: This word describes the low, flat spot where sprawling vines like to spread.
quests.explanation: You got it! Cantaloupe plants sprawl low across the ground rather than climbing upward, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This low-growing habit is very different from fruit trees, which grow tall and upright!

quests.instruction: Before eating a mandarin, you simply ___ its loose skin away with your fingers. What's the word?
quests.question: Peel
quests.hint: This word describes an easy step that needs no knife at all for some fruits.
quests.explanation: Well done! Before eating a mandarin, you simply peel its loose skin away with your fingers, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This fruit is especially easy to prepare this way, thanks to its loose-fitting skin!

quests.instruction: Currants dangle from a low, leafy plant known as a ___. Which word matches?
quests.question: Bush
quests.hint: This word names a shorter plant than a tree, easy to pick standing up.
quests.explanation: Correct! Currants dangle from a low, leafy plant known as a bush, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Several kinds of berries all share this same short, branching kind of plant!

quests.instruction: Before eating a banana, most people first ___ away its yellow skin. What's the word?
quests.question: Peel
quests.hint: This word means to pull the outer skin off a fruit, usually with just your hands.
quests.explanation: Super! Before eating a banana, most people first peel away its yellow skin, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This step is one of the easiest ways to prepare a fruit for eating!

quests.instruction: Before adding it to a sandwich, you might ___ a fresh apple into thin, crisp pieces. Which word fits?
quests.question: Slice
quests.hint: This word describes cutting a fruit with a knife into thin, even pieces.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Before adding it to a sandwich, you might slice a fresh apple into thin, crisp pieces, matching this word!
quests.funFact: A splash of citrus juice can help keep thin fruit pieces like these from turning brown!

quests.instruction: Coconuts dangle far above the ground from the top of a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Palm
quests.hint: This word names a tree famous for its curved trunk and leaves only at the top.
quests.explanation: You found it! Coconuts dangle far above the ground from the top of a palm, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This tree's curved trunk helps it bend safely in strong tropical winds!

quests.instruction: Bakers often ___ a lemon's outer peel to add bright flavor to a cake. What's the word?
quests.question: Zest
quests.hint: This word means to finely grate a citrus fruit's outer peel, not its juice.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Bakers often zest a lemon's outer peel to add bright flavor to a cake, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This step captures the fragrant oils hiding in a citrus fruit's colorful outer layer!

quests.instruction: To reach the juicy sections inside, you first ___ an orange's thick outer layer. Which word fits?
quests.question: Peel
quests.hint: This word describes removing a fruit's outer covering by hand.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! To reach the juicy sections inside, you first peel an orange's thick outer layer, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Some fruits, like this one, practically fall open once their outer layer is removed!

quests.instruction: Watermelons grow low, resting right on the ___, unlike fruit that hangs from a tree. What's the word?
quests.question: Ground
quests.hint: This word names the soil and grass beneath your feet.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Watermelons grow low, resting right on the ground, unlike fruit that hangs from a tree, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This low-growing habit means these fruits are picked by bending down, not reaching up!

quests.instruction: Grapes grow in bunches on a climbing plant called a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This word names a plant that climbs upward, often with the help of a trellis.
quests.explanation: Yes! Grapes grow in bunches on a climbing plant called a vine, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This climbing plant can grow many feet long in just a single season!

quests.instruction: A firm, sour peach will slowly ___ on the counter, growing sweeter and softer each day. What's the word?
quests.question: Ripen
quests.hint: This word names the change a fruit goes through from firm and tart to soft and sweet.
quests.explanation: That's right! A firm, sour peach will slowly ripen on the counter, growing sweeter and softer, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This whole process can take anywhere from a few days to over a week!

quests.instruction: A chef might ___ a fresh lime over a dish to add a zesty splash of flavor. Which word fits?
quests.question: Squeeze
quests.hint: This word describes pressing a fruit to release just a little bit of juice.
quests.explanation: Great job! A chef might squeeze a fresh lime over a dish to add a zesty splash, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Just a small amount of pressing can release a big burst of flavor from citrus fruit!

quests.instruction: Passion fruit and kiwi both often grow on a climbing plant called a ___. What word fits?
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This word names a plant that winds and climbs rather than standing straight up.
quests.explanation: You got it! Passion fruit and kiwi both often grow on a climbing plant called a vine, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Farmers often build wooden frames just to help this climbing plant grow upward!

quests.instruction: Many people choose to ___ a kiwi before eating it, though its fuzzy skin is edible too. What's the word?
quests.question: Peel
quests.hint: This word means to strip away a fruit's outer layer before eating.
quests.explanation: Well done! Many people choose to peel a kiwi before eating it, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This step is optional for a kiwi, since its fuzzy skin is actually safe to eat!

quests.instruction: To top a bowl of yogurt, you might ___ a fresh strawberry into thin pieces. What's the word?
quests.question: Slice
quests.hint: This word means using a knife to divide a fruit into flat pieces.
quests.explanation: Correct! To top a bowl of yogurt, you might slice a fresh strawberry into thin pieces, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Cutting fruit this thin helps it look pretty on top of a bowl of yogurt!

quests.instruction: A firm, tart mango will ___ over several days until it turns soft, sweet, and golden. What's the word?
quests.question: Ripen
quests.hint: This word names the process that turns firm, tart fruit soft and sweet.
quests.explanation: Super! A firm, tart mango will ripen over several days until it turns soft, sweet, and golden, matching this word!
quests.funFact: You can often tell this process is complete just by gently pressing the fruit!

quests.instruction: Blueberries grow on a low, leafy plant called a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Bush
quests.hint: This word names a plant shorter than a tree, with many branching stems.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Blueberries grow on a low, leafy plant called a bush, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This low plant can be picked without needing a ladder at all!

quests.instruction: Dates are harvested from high up in the crown of a tall ___. Which word fits?
quests.question: Palm
quests.hint: This word names a tree with no branches, just leaves clustered at the very top.
quests.explanation: You found it! Dates are harvested from high up in the crown of a tall palm, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Workers sometimes climb this tall tree's trunk by hand to harvest its fruit!

quests.instruction: A hard, green tomato placed in a sunny window will slowly ___ into a soft, red one. Which word matches?
quests.question: Ripen
quests.hint: This word describes the natural transformation from firm and green to soft and colorful.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! A hard, green tomato placed in a sunny window will slowly ripen into a soft, red one, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Sunlight and warmth can both help speed along this natural transformation!

quests.instruction: Lemons and plums both grow up high, hanging from a sturdy ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Tree
quests.hint: This word describes a plant with one thick trunk and many branches.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Lemons and plums both grow up high, hanging from a sturdy tree, matching this word!
quests.funFact: It can take several years before a young one of these produces its very first fruit!
